description: Check a condition on the current page now; never acts. State the expected text in the sentence, e.g. "the order list shows a row with total 42.00". In a learn session a passing assert becomes a flow step that fails the run when it does not hold. Credentials: write each secret as one {{env:NAME}} marker ({{totp:NAME}} for a one-time code), exactly as written: the marker alone, never the value and never $NAME. NAME must be set in the environment the MCP server was started with. Never ask the user for a secret value. isError with exit 1 = the condition did not hold; exit 2 = could not be checked.

condition.description: The condition to check (sent on stdin).

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

session.description: Browser session name (default "default"). Each session is its own browser and daemon.

name: assert
